title: Scheduler journal hotfix R5 — budget-bounded fault processing so corruption bursts commit durable exclusions in chunks (live-ops regression)
description: Live-ops hotfix + R1-R5 audit corrections. R0: eventsSince pages WHERE seq>?; settle() wait_streak decay. R1-F1: fresh wakes reset next_due/wait_streak. R2-F1: usability predicate + lease exclusion in uncharged SQL — unchanged cohorts silent at any size. R3-F1: bounded idle-path integrity sweep (ledger screen + rotating deep verify + dedup'd INTEGRITY_FAULT receipts). R4-F1: screen matches canonical contract (revisions 1..version, count==version, last==version); receipted suspects excluded; tier-2 gets its own quota. R4-F2: faulted_ids durable entity-key exclusion on FAIRNESS_STATE — corrupt shortlisted rows can never starve later candidates. R5-F1: a corruption burst could exhaust the 512-event proof budget mid-transaction, rolling back every fault receipt and exclusion so the same corrupt page was re-selected forever. Fix: store exposes readBudgetRemaining(); the candidate loop stops fault processing at a FAULT_HEADROOM boundary so the transaction COMMITS exclusions already made — guaranteed forward progress, bounded chunks; FAIL_CLOSED_OBJECTIVE_SCHEDULER_PROOF_LIMIT errors are never classified as INTEGRITY_FAULT (transient pressure, not corruption); integritySweep is deferred when remaining budget is under SWEEP_HEADROOM. FAULTED_CAP=1024 fail-closed boundary preserved. Untouched: lease fencing/CAS/retry_count/generation accounting, dedup/idempotency, policy re-proofs, markDue, FAIR_VISIT/FAIR_ROUND decision receipts, per-row hash verification, claim() writer-lock re-proof. Evidence: 26 hotfix tests — failing-first on 5447dad (bursts 80/96/128 threw FAIL_CLOSED_OBJECTIVE_SCHEDULER_PROOF_LIMIT inside fault(), rolling back all progress); green post-fix; adjacent 236/236; tsc clean; build green.
